reproduction.Dockerfile.queue-window-runtime:
FROM once-campfire-goose:queue-window-test AS build
FROM ubuntu:24.04 AS runtime
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates liburing2 libcrypt1 libstdc++6 libqrencode4 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && mkdir -p /rails/storage/db /rails/storage/files /rails/storage/logs \
    && chown -R 1000:1000 /rails
WORKDIR /rails
COPY --from=build /src/build/campfire /usr/local/bin/campfire
COPY assets/reference assets/reference
COPY data data
COPY LICENSE /usr/share/doc/once-campfire-goose/LICENSE
COPY views/MIT-LICENSE /usr/share/doc/once-campfire-goose/MIT-LICENSE
USER 1000:1000
ENV HTTP_PORT=3000 DATABASE_PATH=/rails/storage/db/production.sqlite3 STORAGE_PATH=/rails/storage/files
EXPOSE 3000
ARG GIT_REVISION=unknown
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.source="https://github.com/aardappel/once-campfire-goose" \
      org.opencontainers.image.revision="${GIT_REVISION}" \
      org.opencontainers.image.licenses="Apache-2.0 AND MIT"
CMD ["/usr/local/bin/campfire"]

reproduction.summarize-queue-window.py:
import argparse
import json
import statistics
from pathlib import Path

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--prefix', required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
build = root / 'build'
read = lambda path: json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
directory = build / f'{args.prefix}-comparison'
metadata = read(directory / 'metadata.json')
assert metadata['complete'] and not metadata['goose_dirty'] and not metadata['verification_dirty']
assert metadata['goose_publication_ack'] == 'queued' and metadata['goose_publication_windows'] == [8, 32, 128, 512]
assert metadata['goose_backend'] == 'epoll' and metadata['rounds'] == 3
rows = [read(path) for path in sorted(directory.glob('*-baseline-*.json'))]
assert len(rows) == 15
report = dict(metadata=metadata, rows=rows, samples={}, medians={}, validation={}, excluded_attempts={})
for row in rows:
    variant = row['variant']
    assert variant in ['goose-q8', 'goose-q32', 'goose-q128', 'goose-q512', 'jai']
    if row['app'] == 'goose':
        window = row['publication_window']
        assert variant == f'goose-q{window}'
        assert 'Publication acknowledgement: queued\n' in row['backend_log']
        assert f'Publication window: {window}; delivery permits: {window+56}\n' in row['backend_log']
    assert row['post_write_audit']['verified']
    target = report['samples'].setdefault(variant, {})
    for sample in row['samples']:
        assert sample['errors'] == sample['invalid_responses'] == 0 and sample['ok'] > 0
        target.setdefault(sample['route'], []).append(dict(rps=sample['rps'],
            anonymous_mib=sample['server_anonymous_bytes_after']/1048576,
            container_lifetime_peak_mib=sample['server_container_lifetime_peak_bytes_after']/1048576))
    fanout = row['fanout']
    throughput = fanout['throughput']
    assert fanout['ready'] == fanout['clients'] == 64 and fanout['failed'] == 0
    assert throughput['post_errors'] == 0 and throughput['complete'] == throughput['posted'] > 0
    assert fanout['latency']['post_errors'] == 0 and fanout['latency']['complete'] == 20
    assert fanout['persisted_messages'] == throughput['complete'] + 20
    drained = fanout['phase_metrics']['saturated_drained']
    target.setdefault('fanout', []).append(dict(rps=throughput['delivered_msgs_per_sec'],
        anonymous_mib=drained['anonymous_bytes']/1048576,
        container_lifetime_peak_mib=drained['container_lifetime_peak_bytes']/1048576,
        p99_ms=throughput['all_clients']['p99_ms'], post_p99_ms=throughput['post']['p99_ms'],
        mean_ms=throughput['all_clients']['mean_ms'], drain_seconds=throughput['drain_secs'],
        cpu_us=1e6*(drained['cpu_seconds']-fanout['phase_metrics']['saturated']['cpu_seconds'])/throughput['complete']))
for variant, routes in report['samples'].items():
    assert {r['round'] for r in rows if r['variant'] == variant} == {1, 2, 3}
    report['medians'][variant] = {}
    for route, samples in routes.items():
        assert len(samples) == 3
        stats = {key: statistics.median(sample[key] for sample in samples) for key in samples[0]}
        stats['rate_range'] = [min(s['rps'] for s in samples), max(s['rps'] for s in samples)]
        report['medians'][variant][route] = stats
base = report['medians']['goose-q8']['fanout']['rps']
jai = report['medians']['jai']['fanout']['rps']
report['effects'] = {variant: dict(gain_over_q8_percent=100*(routes['fanout']['rps']/base-1),
    jai_over_goose=jai/routes['fanout']['rps']) for variant, routes in report['medians'].items() if variant.startswith('goose')}

monitor = [json.loads(line) for line in (build / f'{args.prefix}-host-monitor.jsonl').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').splitlines()]
assert not any(m['phase'] == 'interruption' for m in monitor)
measured = [m for m in monitor if m['phase'] == 'measurement']
assert measured and all(m['compilers'] == 0 for m in measured)
last_heavy = set()
activity = {}
for entry in measured:
    heavy = {p['id'] for p in entry['active'] if p['cores'] > .8}
    assert not heavy & last_heavy
    last_heavy = heavy
    for process in entry['active']:
        activity.setdefault(process['name'], []).append(process['cores'])
report['host_monitor'] = dict(samples=monitor, measurement_samples=len(measured),
    background={name: dict(observations=len(values), max_cores=max(values)) for name, values in activity.items()},
    policy='60 seconds without active compilers and three quiet five-second samples below 0.3 core per process; interrupt own runner on any active compiler or same unrelated PID above 0.8 core twice; idle MSBuild permitted below 0.01 core.')
for path in sorted(build.glob('queue-window-quiet*-host-monitor.jsonl')):
    prefix = path.name.removesuffix('-host-monitor.jsonl')
    if prefix == args.prefix:
        continue
    folder = build / f'{prefix}-comparison'
    report['excluded_attempts'][prefix] = dict(
        monitor=[json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').splitlines()],
        metadata=read(folder / 'metadata.json') if (folder / 'metadata.json').exists() else None,
        rows=[read(p) for p in sorted(folder.glob('*-baseline-*.json'))])
for name in ['queue-window-full-test', 'queue-window-native', 'queue-window-native-initial-failure', 'queue-window-native-diagnostic', 'queue-window-parity', 'queue-window-package', 'queue-window-512-package']:
    report['validation'][name] = (build / f'{name}.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
assert report['validation']['queue-window-full-test'].count('512-publication pipelining') == 3
assert report['validation']['queue-window-native'].count('512-publication pipelining') == 2
report['pressure_memory'] = [dict(source=name, **json.loads(line.removeprefix('PRESSURE_MEMORY ')))
    for name in ['queue-window-full-test', 'queue-window-native']
    for line in report['validation'][name].splitlines() if line.startswith('PRESSURE_MEMORY ')]
report['validation']['rendering'] = {ref: read(build / f'queue-window-render-{ref}/result.json') for ref in ['rust', 'jai']}
for cases in report['validation']['rendering'].values():
    assert len(cases) == 27 and all(cases.values())
report['validation']['browser'] = read(build / 'queue-window-browser/receipt.json')
assert report['validation']['browser']['passed']
report['dependencies'] = read(root / 'dependencies.json')
report['jai_policy_review'] = read(build / 'jai-delivery-review/review.json')
report['jai_policy_review_context'] = 'Prior source review: its Goose-policy observation describes the final-drain default. This comparison explicitly selects queued acknowledgement at the recorded capacities.'
report['reference_check'] = read(build / 'queue-window-reference-check.json')
report['checksums'] = (build / 'queue-window-checksums.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
assert len(report['checksums'].splitlines()) == 3
assert {line.split()[0] for line in report['checksums'].splitlines()} == {metadata['executable_sha256']}
report['reproduction'] = {name: (build / name).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig') for name in [
    f'measure-{args.prefix}.sh', f'monitor-{args.prefix}.ps1', 'Dockerfile.queue-window-runtime',
    'Dockerfile.queue-window-512', 'validate-queue-window-native.sh', 'validate-queue-window-parity.sh', 'summarize-queue-window.py']}
print(json.dumps(dict(medians=report['medians'], effects=report['effects'], pressure=report['pressure_memory'],
    host={key:value for key,value in report['host_monitor'].items() if key != 'samples'}), indent=2))
(root / 'docs/publication-queue-sizes-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n')
